text: DR Congo Ebola outbreak reported above 10,000 cases, with CDC cited on spread to Kenya and Nigeria. Al Jazeera separately reports the DRC death toll has passed 5,000. Our CDC-sourced confirmed DRC counts: 9,277 cases, 4,478 deaths.

judge.comment: Headline figures are reported by media and differ from the tracker's CDC-confirmed counts; the tweet states both with attribution. Human check advised on the Kenya/Nigeria spread claim.

factChecks.claim: CDC cited spread to Kenya and Nigeria
factChecks.source: Event title; single-event attribution, not confirmed in KPIs

factChecks.claim: Al Jazeera reports DRC death toll passed 5,000

text: France's interior ministry counted 320,000 demonstrators across the country on Oct 31, with tensions in several cities during dispersals. Interior Minister Nuñez had planned 70,000 police and gendarmes and banned city-centre gatherings.

judge.comment: Figure is an official interior-ministry count, attributed as such; organiser counts are not in the data. Event title names Nuñez but not explicitly as interior minister, so role needs a quick check.
